<?php
// LOCAL TEST SITE ONLY (WordPress Playground), not part of the theme.
// Theme development mode: new pattern files show up without bumping the theme version.
if ( ! defined( 'WP_DEVELOPMENT_MODE' ) ) { define( 'WP_DEVELOPMENT_MODE', 'theme' ); }
// The test server can't reliably reach YouTube's oEmbed service, so build the player directly.
add_filter( 'pre_oembed_result', function ( $result, $url ) {
    if ( preg_match( '~youtube\.com/watch\?v=([\w-]+)~', $url, $m ) ) {
        return '<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $m[1] . '" title="YouTube video" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>';
    }
    return $result;
}, 10, 2 );
